LESSON: READING 9.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: DIALOGUES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Dialogues
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Dialogues, part of Strand 9 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How can we extract information from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording of a dialogue related to the theme,

2. identify vocabulary related to the theme from the text,

3. work jointly to build a vocabulary bank based on the words identified,

4. collaborate to answer direct and inferential questions from the dialogue,

5. infer meaning of vocabulary identified from context,

6. collaborate to paraphrase the key ideas from the text,

7. read the summarised key information in class for peer review,

8. prepare a reading log to track indigenous texts read.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording of a dialogue related to the theme,
2. identify vocabulary related to the theme from the text,
3. work jointly to build a vocabulary bank based on the words identified,
4. collaborate to answer direct and inferential questions from the dialogue,
5. infer meaning of vocabulary identified from context,
6. collaborate to paraphrase the key ideas from the text,
7. read the summarised key information in class for peer review,
8. prepare a reading log to track indigenous texts read.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Dialogues together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner listens to an audio recording of a dialogue related to

the theme.

● Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner is motivated to learn continually by building a vocabulary bank based

on the words identified.

Values:
● Unity: This is promoted as the learner cooperates with peers to paraphrase the key ideas from the text.

● Integrity: This is promoted as the learner displays trustworthiness as they read the summarised key information in class

for peer review.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
